Shadeform is a GPU cloud marketplace exposing a single REST API to deploy and manage GPU compute across many underlying clouds. The API standardizes instance types, availability, and per-GPU-hour pricing across providers, and lets you launch, inspect, restart, update, and delete instances, manage persistent volumes and SSH keys, and save reusable launch templates. All requests are authenticated with an X-API-KEY header.
